verdict.rationale: Groq documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with explicit base_url/api_key swap instructions, so tools built on OpenAI clients can be pointed at it. Its llms.txt also shows first-party integration pages exist under console.groq.com/docs (e.g., JigsawStack). However, the pack contains no named, first-party guides for specific coding agents or agent frameworks. missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides for named coding agents (e.g., IDE/CLI agents) and agent frameworks, evidence of breadth of the integrations catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent/framework setups.
